title: Vega & Vinnie’s: the rename, the outside from the owner's 13 photos, the patio sized to the inside, and a seamless walk out to the lot
lensAText: FIRST open the owner's 13 references in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-Claude/104ede24-b5bc-5131-bb4c-1bc7e86a4fd2/scratchpad/owner/vega-vinnies/ with the Read tool (they govern the look; no real team logo, our own tenant names, no real car badges). Then: a sceptical environment art director for a premium driving/life-sim game. Look at every side-by-side the builder cites with the Read tool, then build the standalone venue page and dist/artifact.html yourself and take your own frames in ONE short Playwright script at 1280x720 and 390x844 (phone viewport copy, isMobile, hasTouch, DPR 3), day and night: the front, the pylon from the lot, the lot walkway, the strip corner, the exit street with the overpass, the substation wall, the patio at night, and a 10-frame walk from the host stand out the door to your car. Judge: how close is each view to its photo (ranked differences); is every player-facing name now Vega & Vinnie’s with no Stoppage Time left; is the patio ratio printed and within 3-4x; is the walk out truly seamless (no fade, no load, no camera pop, no black or empty frame at the doorway); does the Car button walk you out; Low cheap, HD/Ultra at S4's bar; budgets and the venue groups green. Reject on a copied real logo, mapped things moved to match a photo, or any black/blank frame at the threshold.
